TOKENAMUN  what-if: caveman

compress agent-facing content the way Caveman claims to
Session carry-fixture, 8 API calls

Observed
  retrieved content                                 12.0 KB   [observed]
  eligible tool and MCP output                       1.1 KB   [observed]
  eligible items                                          3   [observed]

Derived
  compression ratio applied                           50.0%   [derived]
      assumed surviving fraction 0.50, stated rather than measured
  eligible content, estimated tokens                    179   [derived]
  carry cost of eligible content                        259   [derived]

Counterfactual
  compressed size                                     540 B   [counterfactual]
  bytes removed                                       540 B   [counterfactual]
  carry cost avoided, before invalidation              -129   [counterfactual]
      proportional to the content removed; the cache-invalidation cost of
      rewriting context is in unknown, not netted out here
  local reduction of eligible content                 50.0%   [counterfactual]
      a local reduction is not a session saving and is not presented as
      one

Unknown
  - additional_tool_calls: content the agent could no longer read may have
    been fetched again.
  - cache_invalidation_point: rewriting context breaks the cached prefix
    from that point, converting cheap reads into full-price writes. Where
    the change point cannot be determined this is not netted out.
  - behavioural_change: the agent's trajectory is assumed identical. It
    would not have been.
  - task_success: not observable from this data. An agent that fails the
    task consumes the fewest tokens of all, so a reduction is not an
    improvement.
  - published_ratio: Caveman's own figure is a 65% output reduction, while
    an independent test measured 8.5% on real agentic tasks. Neither was
    measured here. Use --replay-with to pipe this session's own content
    through the real compressor and settle it for this repository.
